# ex: assigneeType via struct composite literal element
ex {
	var x int
	F(x) -> G(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type S struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func F(x int) int { return x }
func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

var s = S{F(1), F(2)}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -8,4 +8,4 @@
 func F(x int) int { return x }
 func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

-var s = S{F(1), F(2)}
+var s = S{G(1), G(2)}
